items.caption: A modern redraw in small-seal style has a rounded U-shaped outer contour with two tall side uprights. A taller central stem branches into two diagonals that meet the contour near its lower portion.
items.alt: A rounded U-shaped outline with two tall side uprights surrounds an open center. A taller central stem branches diagonally to meet the inner sides of the outline near the bottom.
items.selection_reason: Shows a modern small-seal-style rendering whose enclosing contour and branching central stem are clear. It illustrates the visible form without establishing ancient stroke lineage or a chronological transition.
items.period: Seal-script tradition; specimen date not established

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw in small-seal style, not an ancient inscription image. Its visible shape does not establish a specimen date or a continuous sequence of graphic changes.
